COMWAY A3+ Fusion Splicer – Best Fiber Optic Splicing Machine in Bangladesh (2025)

 High-Precision, Fast & Reliable Fiber Optic Splicing Solution

The COMWAY A3+ Fusion Splicer is a high-performance fiber splicing machine designed for FTTH applications, telecom networks, and fiber optic professionals. Engineered with advanced core alignment technology, this device ensures fast, precise, and reliable splicing results every time.


With a user-friendly interface, ultra-fast splicing time (5 sec.), and a durable, compact design, the COMWAY A3+ is the best choice for fiber optic network deployment. Now available in Bangladesh at the best price D CORE Solutions.


Key Features 

  • Advanced Core Alignment (4 Motors) – Ensures high-precision splicing for single-mode & multi-mode fibers
  • Ultra-Fast Splicing Speed – 5 sec. splicing & 15 sec. heating for maximum efficiency
  • User-Friendly 4.1-inch Touch Screen – Easy operation with real-time monitoring
  • High-Performance Battery – 4000mAh battery allows over 240 splicing & heating cycles
  • Durable & Portable Design – Waterproof, dustproof, and shockproof for extreme environments
  • Smart Splice Loss Estimation – Minimizes errors and ensures low splice loss
  • Dual Camera System (300x Magnification) – Superior fiber viewing for accurate alignment
  • Large Data Storage Capacity – Stores up to 20,000 splice records & 300 splice images
  • Multiple Splicing Programs (100) & Heating Programs (30) – Customizable settings for different fiber types


COMWAY A3+ Technical Specifications

  • Motor Number: 4 Motors
  • Fiber Alignment: High Precision PAS Alignment
  • Fiber Types Supported: SM (ITU-T G.652), MM (G.651), DS (G.653), NZDS (G.655), BI (G.657)
  • Splicing Time: 5 sec. (Fast Mode), 15 sec. (Standard Mode)
  • Heating Time: 15 sec. (Adjustable)
  • Splice Loss: SM: 0.02dB, MM: 0.01dB, DS: 0.04dB, NZDS: 0.04dB, BI: 0.02dB
  • Return Loss: >60dB
  • Display: 4.1-inch High-Light Color Screen
  • Electrode Life: 5,000 arc discharges
  • Battery Capacity: 4000mAh (Supports 240+ splicing & heating cycles)
  • USB Port: High-speed data transfer & firmware updates
  • Operating Conditions: -20°C to +50°C, Humidity 0-95%, Altitude 0-5000m


Why Choose the COMWAY A3+ Fusion Splicer?

  • Best Fiber Optic Splicing Machine for Telecom Professionals
  • Fastest Splicing & Heating Time for Maximum Productivity
  • Rugged, Waterproof & Shockproof Design – Built for Harsh Environment Long Battery Life – Ideal for Fieldwork & Outdoor Use
  • Competitive Price in Bangladesh (2025) – Best Value for Your Money
